rows.en: This is it, huh.
Cover me with fire! Got it?
Don't let them get too close! Attack from range!
Use your ranged weapons!
Take it to close quarters!
Melee! Get ready... go!
Melee! Stop it!
I'll hold this one off!
Don't overextend!
Stay back as far as you can.
All weapons free! Do it!
Show them what you've got!
Give it everything!
Guess I have to get serious.
Don't underestimate me!
Time to wrap this up.
Understood.
Got it.
All right.
Captain, you've taken a lot of damage.
You're not at your sharpest today, Captain.
Captain, maybe you should return to base for now.
Captain!?
rows.notes: Heard "taishou" (target); read as "taichou" (captain) per the neighbouring clips.

rows.en: Captain! Captain!
The Captain's been shot down!
We're pulling out!
No good. We'll pull back for now.
This isn't good. We're heading back.
rows.notes: Heard "warukunai na" (not bad); fits a retreat group better as "yokunai na" (not good).

rows.en: As expected of you, Captain.
We're following the Captain's lead!
You've gotten better, Alto.
Well done, Michael.
Don't think you can fight on a whim.
Can you fight with skills like an amateur's?
Can you keep up on my tail with those skills?
Let's go! Can you keep up?
I'm counting on you.
Let's take them out fast.
Flying with you isn't so bad.
You're finally starting to look the part.
Let's see how much you've improved.
You're good enough to watch my back now.
One slip and you'll leave me behind.
You and I can protect everyone.
Fly like that and you'll get yourself killed someday.
What are you fighting for?
Not good at all.
You weren't dead weight, at least.
You've got potential, kid.
Not bad for a greenhorn.
You've improved a lot.
Can't call you a greenhorn anymore.
You're handling your machine well.
You're a full-fledged pilot now.
All right! Tonight's on me! Stick with me till morning!
You can fly at my side anytime.
Maybe you should stay holed up in your room.
rows.notes: Heard "heya ni tsukkonde" (charge into the room); probably "hikkonde" (hole up).

rows.en: Whatever you do, don't get in front of me.
Don't get lost, greenhorn!
Follow me! I'll teach you how to fight!
Forget about women when you fight!
Better than flying with some smelly guy.
Let's give them a nasty surprise!
Show me what a greenhorn's made of.
Just don't do anything reckless.
I'll protect you, and your dream too!
Got to protect the women who matter to me.
Flying with you isn't bad.
Why not hold a frying pan instead of a control stick?
Maybe you're just not cut out for this.
Aren't you on the wrong path?
Lucky you. Keep it up next time.
Okay, heading back. Keep up.
Well, you didn't get in the way.
Passable. Not bad.
Keep it up like that from now on.
I could watch you without worrying.
Skills that put a man to shame.
Some woman, really.
From now on, cover my back too.
